system.description: The psychic can form a bond with another person over a distance and against his will. To do so, he must have a sympathetic focus, an item that bears the target’s psychic resonance, such as a well-worn item of his clothing, a lock of hair, fingernail clippings, etc. These items must have a relatively fresh connection to the target, having been on him within the past month. The psychic does not need to meditate or spend more than 1 Wyrd point, but the duration of the Mojo Bond may not be extended—he has 10 turns in which to gain his advantage.
